name: purescript-sha3-php
description: SHA-3 for PureScript on the phpurs (PHP) backend

scripts.test: spago build && php -d opcache.enable_cli=1 -d opcache.jit=tracing -d opcache.jit_buffer_size=64M output/main.php
scripts.bench: spago build && BENCH=1 php -d opcache.enable_cli=1 -d opcache.jit=tracing -d opcache.jit_buffer_size=64M output/main.php
